en: From barge to pleasure boat – that's why canoes have cult status in Thunder Bay. Storm, sun, fog: In the area around the Canadian city, the weather changes faster than you can paddle. But you have civilization behind you in two or three strokes and can delve deep into the interesting history of the transport of goods by sea.
